accepted.sentence: In bathrooms, wall-mounted units above sinks hold toiletries while keeping them away from splashing water.
In clinics, lockable compartments keep medications and medical supplies inaccessible to unauthorized visitors.
In offices, shallow drawers with labeled fronts help staff sort paperwork by client, date, or project.
In shops, glass-fronted displays let customers view merchandise while limiting direct handling.
In classrooms, dedicated storage for art materials helps teachers distribute supplies and return them after activities.
Laboratories use approved flammable-liquid storage units designed to reduce fire exposure and contain hazardous vapors.
In living rooms, enclosed media storage can hide electronic equipment while leaving openings for cables and remote signals.
On boats, compact storage with secure catches keeps equipment from shifting when the vessel moves through waves.
